hooks.command:
echo '
📋 Session end checklist:
  1. Update progress.md (what was done, next step)
  2. Update feature_list.json (mark items if DoD met)
  3. Commit clean state
  4. Smoke test the skill on a sample PR (or ./init.sh for non-skill changes)
'
if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE 'git commit|git push'; then echo '⚠️  Pre-commit: run ./init.sh first if not done yet'; fi
